mapper.sql: I.INQUIRY_ID AS ID, I.USER_ID, I.CATEGORY, I.TITLE, I.CONTENT, I.STATUS, I.ANSWER, DATE_FORMAT(I.CREATED_AT, '%Y-%m-%d') AS `DATE`, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.ANSWERED_AT) * 1000 AS ANSWERED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(I.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO INQUIRY (INQUIRY_ID, USER_ID, CATEGORY, TITLE, CONTENT, STATUS) VALUES (#{id}, #{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, #{status})
mapper.update:
UPDATE INQUIRY
ANSWER = #{answer}, ANSWERED_BY = #{answeredBy}, ANSWERED_AT = NOW(),
STATUS = #{status},
WHERE INQUIRY_ID = #{id} AND IS_DELETED = 'N'
